correctness.rationale: For every core H and m_v>d_H(v), private leaves copy their center at the first step; unanimous blocks strictly determine each center at the next step. Hence the recurrent block words swap, F^3=F, and all periodic-state/first-entry counts hold. Counting initial leaf support per center and multiplying exact binomial factors gives each fixed or primitive-two orbit basin. A concrete strict-threshold boundary witness and two independently implemented exhaustive trajectory checkers corroborate every critical step.

value.rationale: The complete attractor/basin structure for every finite base graph and all heterogeneous leaf-dominating pendant multiplicities is a natural structural classification, not a graph-specific numerical census. It identifies topology-independent orbit counts but explicitly topology-sensitive basin weights, and quantifies immediate recurrence probability 2^(k-M), with exponential core-edge sensitivity. The old tree passive-vertex sublemma is credited rather than independently claimed.
